statement: A lossless CBOR encoder for the canonical IR exists
evidence_or_gap: CborPayload is #[derive(Serialize,Deserialize)] schema scaffolding only; no encode fn exists; the struct is constructed nowhere in the workspace (grep: only its definition and one comment)

statement: A bounded, validated CBOR decoder for the canonical IR exists
evidence_or_gap: No decoder; no size bounds before allocation for a CBOR IR path. ir_stream::DecodeLimits/AssemblerLimits exist for the wire framing but are not wired to any CBOR IR decode

statement: CBOR decode(encode(ir)) yields the same canonical semantic state as parse(emit_hymeko(ir))
evidence_or_gap: No codec, so no round-trip. When built it must equal the text round-trip proven for the transformation emit_hymeko path

statement: CborPayload embeds derived/duplicated state alongside the canonical ir
evidence_or_gap: Fields: ir=canonical; interned_strings=canonical companion but duplicates the string table; index and canon_hash=derived/cache recomputable from ir; root_path,imports=transport. A future decoder must recompute-and-verify index and canon_hash rather than trust them

statement: CborPayload.root_path is environment metadata, not portable canonical data
evidence_or_gap: root_path: PathBuf serialises an absolute host path into a shareable snapshot/QR; a portable snapshot must store a workspace-relative path or a module key

statement: Source emission (IrWriter) reproduces the full IR semantics
evidence_or_gap: IrWriter emits the declaration skeleton (names + hierarchy) only. Annotations, values, bases and hyperarc incidences are NOT emitted (arcs stub to '/* Arc references pending */'). Deterministic for the supported subset (UIR-M2B-01)

statement: Emitted HyMeKo source reparses to an equivalent IR (lossless text round-trip)
evidence_or_gap: Blocked by UIR-EMIT-01: emission is skeleton-only so a lossless emit->reparse round-trip is not achievable in core today. (The transformation crate's emit_hymeko is complete and its round-trip is tested there.)
